entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕字面疑为『最假之色穀（以假色伪装的穀物）』
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 literally 'most falsely coloured grain', undetermined
entries.notes: 西栏 Vanos entodos 讹误难解；汉字『最假色穀』非常用语，音读 tsuè-ké-sek-kak 与四字相合但语义无法定夺。
汉字与音读互证为『俊俏』（tsùn-tsiáu）；西栏 Vano（虚荣）义与汉义不合，疑西栏讹录，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕西栏似指自大轻佻、放荡无度之人，汉字『淵人』不成词
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 Spanish suggests a vain, disorderly gallant; '淵人' not a standard term
entries.notes: 『淵人』不成词且音读 ién-lāng 与之难证，西栏 Vanos, galán, fin orden 多词讹混，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: smoke and dust raised from the ground; earthly vapours

entries.zh: 氤氲；天地间迷蒙之雾气
entries.en: dense misty vapour (of earth or water)
water vapour; damp exhalation from wet things

entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕西义为衙役所执之杖；汉字形似『笠』与音读及西义均不合
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 Spanish sense 'constable's staff/rod of office'; Chinese column '笠' (bamboo hat) irreconcilable
entries.notes: 『笠』常用音为 le̍k 而本条音读 chûe（tsuè），与西义 vara『杖』三栏互证俱失败，不敢定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕疑指衙役拘人所执之杖棍，『狗笠』不成词
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 likely a constable's arresting staff; compound '狗笠' not a standard term
entries.notes: 『狗』疑为『拘』形讹（同声旁），次字与音读 káu-tsuè 及西义 vara de alguazil 均不合，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕西义为拿捉孩童之杖，『拿』＝捉拿与 coger 相合而次字难解
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 staff for seizing boys; first character 拿 matches 'coger', second unclear
entries.notes: 首字『拿』与西义 coger 相合，次字『笠』与音读 tsuè 不合，整体释义存疑。
汉字与音读互证为『竹桥』（tsek-kó）；西栏 Vara d.l fir muei nario 讹误难解，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕『舡』即船；次字『汗』不成词，西栏疑与泊船处/船坞相关
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 '舡' = boat; second character unclear; Spanish possibly a shipyard/careening place
entries.notes: 『舡汗』不成词；西栏 Varadex 讹误，疑与 varadero（泊船修船处）相关但无确证，不敢定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕汉字『乾』字面为『干』，音读 fá 与西栏 Varon 均不合，疑栏位错位
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 Chinese '乾' literally 'dry', but reading 'fá' and Spanish 'varón' irreconcilable
entries.notes: 汉字、音读、西栏三者互不合（乾≠varón≠fá），疑栏位错位或字形讹录，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残讹，释义存疑〕字面疑为『旱埔（干燥平地）』，音读 fá-pó 与西栏 Varon 均不合
entries.en: 〔headword garbled; meaning uncertain〕 literally 'dry flat land', irreconcilable with reading 'fá-pó' and Spanish 'varón'
entries.notes: 同上条三栏互不合；『埔』＝平地可从，首字与栏位关系存疑，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 翁；老翁、长者（尊长、主人之称）
